There are thirty students in my class.
I have a problem with my computer.
Can I ask you a question?

items.sentenceEn: My classmate helps me with my homework.

items.audioZh: 我有一個關於作業的問題，你可以幫我嗎？

items.sentenceEn: Draw an underline under each new word.
items.sentenceZh: 在每個新字下面畫一條底線。

items.sentenceEn: The students write their names on the paper.
items.sentenceZh: 學生們把名字寫在紙上。

items.stemZh: 我可以問你一個問題嗎？

items.stemEn: Tom and I are in the same class. He is my ____.
items.stemZh: Tom 和我同班，他是我的同班同學。

items.passageEn: Kevin is a new student at our school. He is from Japan, and his English is not very good. He often has problems with his homework. His classmate Lisa helps him every day after school. Now Kevin can answer many questions in class.
items.passageZh: Kevin 是我們學校的新學生。他來自日本，英文不太好，常常在功課上遇到問題。他的同學 Lisa 每天放學後都幫他。現在 Kevin 在課堂上能回答很多問題了。

options: 他在日本的一個老朋友
學校裡新來的英文老師

referenceEn: I have a lot of homework today.
I have lots of homework today.
rubricZh: homework 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 a homework
「很多」可用 a lot of、lots of 等

items.promptZh: 我奶奶每個月寫信給我。
referenceEn: My grandmother writes a letter to me every month.
Every month, my grandma writes me a letter.
rubricZh: write 後面接寫的東西（例如 a letter），寫給誰可用 to 或直接接人（例如 writes me a letter）
習慣性的事用現在簡單式（例如 writes）
